types.opaque_id: Nonempty bounded ASCII identifier, no credential or imported path semantics; exact maximum fixed in reviewed channel schema.
types.sha256: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters identifying raw frozen bytes under the declared canonicalization.
types.utc_timestamp: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with explicit Z offset; compare with independently pinned UTC/monotonic clock evidence.
types.positive_integer: JSON integer greater than zero; booleans are not integers.

existing_gate_mapping.verified_role_read_isolation_receipt_sha: role_read_isolation_receipt_sha256 with externally selected observer and exact topology/execution binding
existing_gate_mapping.authorized_controller_release_receipt_sh: Raw digest of authenticated, durably consumed successor receipt; not this source contract

rules: No required field may be null, absent, unknown or self-declared verified.
Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys and mismatched referenced identities block consumption.
Select receipt producer/authentication and observer outside payload; verify actual issuer and peer against trusted configuration.
Hashes are bindings, not credentials, grants or proof of actual access denial.
Atomically consume release_id once before first current-frame delivery; unknown consumption outcome blocks without blind resend.
One receipt authorizes one bounded execution/channel; every frame/event remains separately sequenced and at-most-once.
Any changed process, boot, mount, source, model, config, peer, epoch or expiry invalidates the binding and blocks delivery.
Durable exposure intent precedes private delivery including non-generating render/tokenize.
Preserve inherited pair exposure, attempts, failures and retries across generation01/02.
Do not modify the frozen generation02 release-gate.json to manufacture authorization.
